description: This Java class acts as a command handler within the Fineract project. It processes commands related to allocating a cashier to a teller by invoking the appropriate service method.

classes.name: AllocateCashierToTellerCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service component that handles commands for allocating a cashier to a teller, implementing NewCommandSourceHandler.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming command to allocate a cashier to a teller by delegating to the TellerWritePlatformService.
